name: Painmistress Gabrissa
shortDescription: The Illidari jailer whose key opens the demonic crystals holding Ar’tor’s body.
body: The Illidari jailer whose key opens the demonic crystals holding Ar’tor’s body. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
